name: Kidney Beans
siboNotes: High galactan content can feed bacteria in SIBO patients. Start with very small portions (1-2 tablespoons) if tolerated during maintenance phase.
preparationTips: Rinse canned beans thoroughly to reduce FODMAP content
Start with small portions and gradually increase if well-tolerated
Combine with low-FODMAP grains like rice to create complete protein
Consider using bean liquid (aquafaba) in small amounts as it's lower FODMAP than whole beans
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in fiber for digestive health
Good source of folate and iron
